diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only user1-related failures: user1 reported 'Network unreachable' to off-subnet destinations, while web1/app1 returned unreachable or no reply toward 10.10.10.10 and all other tested paths were healthy. Read evidence showed user1 eth1 was DOWN and had no default route; leaf1 ethernet-1/10 was enabled with 10.10.10.1/24 but lower-layer-down toward user1. I restored user1 eth1 to admin up and added default route via 10.10.10.1 on eth1. Final public success criteria validation passed with all lab connectivity checks successful.
diagnosis.reference: On user1, interface eth1 (users_vlan segment) is administratively down (shut down).

arguments.name: eth1
arguments.reason: user1 eth1 is DOWN with no default route, while leaf1 ethernet-1/10 is enabled but lower-layer-down toward the users VLAN; restoring the affected host access link is the narrow evidence-based fix.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: user1 now has eth1 up and connected route 10.10.10.0/24, but still lacks the required default route, which matches the 'Network unreachable' failure for all off-subnet destinations while other paths remain healthy.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1

action.command: ip link set dev eth1 up
action.reason: user1 eth1 is DOWN with no default route, while leaf1 ethernet-1/10 is enabled but lower-layer-down toward the users VLAN; restoring the affected host access link is the narrow evidence-based fix.

final_response.summary: Observed only user1-related failures: user1 reported 'Network unreachable' to off-subnet destinations, while web1/app1 returned unreachable or no reply toward 10.10.10.10 and all other tested paths were healthy. Read evidence showed user1 eth1 was DOWN and had no default route; leaf1 ethernet-1/10 was enabled with 10.10.10.1/24 but lower-layer-down toward user1. I restored user1 eth1 to admin up and added default route via 10.10.10.1 on eth1. Final public success criteria validation passed with all lab connectivity checks successful.
